acceptanceCriteria: The adapter answers Read/Grep PreToolUse with `defer` plus bounded additionalContext or a degradation code, covered by a test that it never emits deny or ask.
The spec states whether hook-driven unplanned-read recording is admitted under AGENTS.md invariant 4, with a decision reference.
Measured p95 hook latency on the Corvint repository stays under the configured hook timeout.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. PreToolUse returns `additionalContext` and a `permissionDecision` of allow, deny, ask or defer (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks). A Read/Grep matcher could add, at the moment a file is opened, its owning spec, covering tests and co-change neighbours from the index snapshot, and could feed the unplanned-read ledger without the operator marker. Corvint holds no authority to block a read, so the adapter must always return `defer`, never `deny` or `ask`. Open questions: the 2 s hook timeout against index load, and whether the ledger write stays inside invariant 4 when driven by a hook instead of the marker. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: hosts: point-of-use context on Claude Code `PreToolUse` for Read and Grep
